sane: The database now tracks races, racial abilities, classes, maps, areas and every spell's effect values, each with its history
The database took this build and its hotfixes: 67 new and 458 changed items, 16 new and 332 changed spells, 97 talents, 86 recipes, 28 Legacy nodes, 15 racial abilities and 2 flights
Navigation's walking data was made anew for both continents and Zephras Isle
Abilities' spellbook window follows the game's narrower one; the settings' colour picker and the bags take what is new
62 pictures of the map are queued to be painted again from this build's terrain

points.text: Everything here is compared with build 70245, the last build our database and map were read from
The interface alone is compared with build 70532, the export before this one.
Mace Specialization is replaced by Artisan's Precision: spell and attack hit chance increased by 1%
points.was: critical chance increased by 1% with Maces

points.text: Find Treasure's short line now adds a chance to find more valuables in chests
Eureka!: reduced cost and 10% more damage or healing now lasts 8 seconds
points.was: on the next 3 spells or abilities

points.text: Read Ley Line is renamed Read Leyline: Health and Mana regeneration increased by 50% for 15 seconds
Its cast time is now 0.5 seconds (was 2 seconds)
Wind Blessed: Haste increased by 2%
Walk on Air cooldown reduced to 1.5 minutes
Sword Specialization is replaced by Ruthless: critical chance increased by 1%
The Human Spirit: Spirit increased by 10%
Axe Specialization is replaced by Command: Hunter and Warlock pets deal 5% more damage
points.was: critical chance increased by 1% with Axes

points.text: Shatter Curse now removes Banes and Curses and reduces Magical damage taken by 5%
Endurance no longer increases Hit Chance by 1%; it still increases total Health by 5%
Plainsrunning now stacks movement speed while moving
points.was: Self and Party movement speed increased by 2%

points.text: Cultivation now has a 15-minute cooldown
War Stomp cooldown reduced to 1.5 minutes
Regeneration: 20% of Health regeneration continues in combat, and it is increased by 20% at all times
Skysight: movement speed increased by 15% for 15 seconds
Wind Blessed: Haste increased by 2%
Walk on Air cooldown reduced to 1.5 minutes
Wild Growth now has a 3-second cast time at every rank
Primal Bite's weapon damage value increased: rank 1 to 42 (was 26), rank 3 to 77 (was 59)
Shred's weapon damage value reduced to 22
Thorns damage reduced at every rank: rank 1 to 3 (was 4), rank 6 to 18 (was 22)
Bear Form's threat bonus increased to 50%
Wrath gains less damage per level: rank 1 to 0.2 (was 0.4)
Ferocious Bite gains a new first rank, for 6 ranks in all
Lacerate gains two new first ranks, for 5 ranks in all
Shifting Power cooldown reduced to 8 seconds
Swiftmend's description now says your own Rejuvenation or Regrowth must be on the target
Berserk and Improved Shifting Power are no longer talents
Primal Bite takes Berserk's place, Lacerate takes Primal Bite's, Predatory Discipline takes Shifting Power's, and Shifting Power takes Improved Shifting Power's
Bloom replaces Gift of the Earthmother, and Predatory Instincts is renamed Natural Instinct
Furor swaps places with Heart of the Wild, and Reflection with Subtlety
Immolation Trap and Explosive Trap lose the word Effect from their names at every rank
Sonic Blast (pet) cooldown increased to 1 minute at every rank
Aspect of the Hawk's ranged attack power reduced at every rank: rank 1 to 15 (was 20), rank 5 to 47 (was 90)
Trueshot Aura rank 1 now gives 15
Improved Revive Pet and Pathfinding moved in the talent tree
Arcane Blast cast time reduced to 1.5 seconds at every rank
Its base damage falls with it: rank 1 to 32 (was 54), rank 5 to 236 (was 394)
Fireball's top rank hits harder and its first gains less per level: rank 5 base damage 120 (was 108), rank 1 per level 0.2 (was 0.6)
Ice Lance now has an 8-second cooldown at every rank
Precision, renamed from Elemental Precision, now has 3 ranks
Fire Power now has 3 ranks
Incineration now has 5 ranks
Improved Fireball is renamed Accelerant, and Wake of Fire is renamed Improved Fire Blast
Missile Barrage and Arcane Resilience swap places in the talent tree
Improved Blizzard, Frost Channeling, Frostbite and Permafrost moved
Holy Shield mana cost reduced to 100, 150 and 195 by rank, with a new fourth rank
Its effect value falls too: rank 1 to 75 (was 110), rank 3 to 153 (was 221)
Righteous Fury's threat bonus increased to 90%
Retribution Aura damage reduced at every rank: rank 1 to 5 (was 7), rank 5 to 20 (was 30)
Light's Vigil range increased to 40 yards at every rank
Swift Judgement now has a 10-yard range and its own description
New talents: Turn Evil, Divine Strength and Boundless Light
Oath of Light replaces Voice of Truth, Stoicism replaces Divine Strength, Shieldsworn replaces Improved Seal of Fury, and Unsealed Wrath replaces Twist of Light
More ranks: Improved Seals 5 (was 3), Spiritual Focus 5 (was 2), Champion of the Light 5 (was 3)
Fewer ranks: Divine Precision 2 (was 3), Reverence 2 (was 3), Shield Specialization 2 (was 3), Conviction 3 (was 5), Iron Creed 3 (was 5)
All three talent trees are rearranged, with 38 talents changed
Devouring Plague cooldown reduced to 24 seconds at every rank
Vampiric Embrace cooldown reduced to 30 seconds
Shadow Word: Death cooldown increased to 18 seconds at every rank
Penance mana cost increased to 150, 220 and 385 by rank
Heal amount reduced: rank 1 to 270 (was 291), rank 2 to 375 (was 405)
Lesser Heal gains less per level, and rank 3 heals for 163
Smite gains less damage per level at every rank: rank 1 to 0.1 (was 0.5)
Holy Fire rank 1 base damage reduced to 54
Dark Inspiration replaces Improved Fade with 5 ranks, Improved Mind Blast replaces Shadow Affinity with 5 ranks, and Holy Binding replaces Binding Heal
Chain Lightning mana cost reduced to 145, 200, 250 and 315 by rank
Fire Nova mana cost reduced to 65, 120, 210, 290 and 375 by rank
Lava Burst mana cost reduced to 135, 165 and 230 by rank
Rank 1 base damage falls to 123 (was 164)
Lightning Bolt gains less damage per level, and rank 5 base damage rises to 82
Mana Tide Totem mana cost reduced to 20 and 30 by rank
Lava Burst, Elemental Mastery, Earthbound and Lightning Overload are rearranged in the talent tree
Improved Fire Nova is renamed Trial by Fire, Elemental Warding swaps with Elemental Alacrity, and Totemic Focus with Tidal Focus
Portal of Summoning cooldown increased to 1 hour
Grim Reach replaces Malediction, with 2 ranks
Furious Precision replaces Boundless Rage, and Lingering Rage replaces Iron Will
Bloodthirst's value increased to 45 at every rank
The talent trees are rearranged, with 15 talents changed
Grubbis's difficulty value changes to 1
Shade of the Archmage and Rath'mael move later in their instance's boss order
67 items added, among them Thunderfury, Sulfuras, Benediction, Anathema and Rhok'delar under new item numbers
A set of Elixirs and Scrolls of Endless effects, and Noggenfogger Elixir, Superior Healing Potion and Superior Mana Potion
New items for jewelry and weapons such as Choker of the Fire Lord, Quick Strike Ring and Earthshaker
Battleground Marks of Honor now stack to 30, for all four battlegrounds
Intact Limbs now stack to 50
Potion of Predatory Senses, renamed from Draught, now lasts 1.5 minutes
The Lesser Intellect effect now lasts 30 minutes
Tomes such as Tome of Arcane Domination and items such as Lei of the Lifegiver and The Immovable Object drop to item level 60
Weapon speed: Whisper 3.4 (was 3.2), Abandoned Ferocity 3.2 (was 2.7), Rage of the Storm 3.2 (was 3.6)
458 items changed in all: 144 sell prices, most of them lower, 92 item levels, 91 qualities, 57 names and 42 required levels
Every one stands in the list of every change at the foot of this page.
Replica Dartol's Rod of Transformation is now a toy
The challenge Play in the WoW: Forever Beta now rewards 1
The Legacy trees are rearranged, with 27 perks moved
New enchant: Enchant Boots - Speed, with its formula
New plans and patterns teach chain and leather armor, and new formulas teach the Hearts of the Mountain
34 recipes change the skill where they turn yellow, and 30 where they turn grey
Recipes that make shoulders now say Shoulders in their names
Guardians of Hyjal has a new description
The Forever Experience Preset is now set by two calls, one before and one after login
New: a pet's pending move order can be read, with an event when it changes, and an event when a settings header changes
Loss of Control data follows a new restriction on what addons can read during it
The game's spellbook window is narrower
Bag slots gain their own empty-slot icon, and item buttons gain a mask
116 interface code files and 3 pictures changed
Western Kalimdor was reshaped: the ground rose or fell by up to 125 yards around Mulgore, Desolace, The Barrens, Thunder Bluff and Shen'dralas, and up to 31 yards around Stonetalon Mountains
Water changed in Felwood, Ashenvale, Mount Hyjal, Stonetalon Mountains and The Barrens
Smaller changes to the ground in the Eastern Kingdoms: up to 35 yards around Eastern Plaguelands, 21 yards around Tirisfal Glades, and 7 yards around Wetlands, Loch Modan and Dun Morogh
New areas: Dreambound Pinnacle, Twilight Hollow, Hyjal Crater and Sunken Hollow
New maps: Dalaran Skycuter and Mulgore Skycuter
Hyjal Crater's map now counts as a world map
Doodads moved across Duskwood, Wetlands, Loch Modan, Dun Morogh and Stranglethorn Vale, and 15 buildings and 19 models changed
A quest flight path is added on Zephras Isle at the Spires Wind Bridge, and two flight paths are a little shorter
Dalaran's area now counts as Alliance, and Timbermaw Hold's mount rules changed
The Darkmoon Faire's dates now stand in the client

sane: The database took this build and its hotfixes: 14 new and 139 changed spells, 3 new and 42 changed talents, 7 class skill lines, 1 new and 6 changed items; 2 spells, 1 talent, 1 achievement and 1 option gone
Social's contacts menu offers your broadcast in Retail alone, as Forever's own took it out; a friend's game icon shows Forever's sub icon
Nameplates' combat text writes Forever's hidden amounts as they are, and a blow blocked, absorbed or resisted whole as its word
The settings' option labels and Sync's pages no longer list Broadcast Updates
Nothing in the world moved, so no walking data or painting of the map was made anew

points.text: Everything here is compared with build 70707, the build before, each with the hotfixes the game held that day
Blizzard has published no patch notes or hotfixes for WoW: Forever for this build; looked for on 2026-11-03.
The achievement Played in the WoW: Forever Beta is gone
High Order Skyborne and Windshaper Skyborne characters' customization now lists Feathers before Feather Color
Command gets an icon and a second effect of 5%
The counters of class talent resets and Legacy talent resets now recharge every 7 days
Claw now deals 140% weapon damage at every rank
Shred now deals 200% weapon damage at every rank
Ravage now deals 435% weapon damage at every rank
Rake hits harder at every rank: rank 1 deals 27 and 20 a tick (was 23 and 16), rank 4 76 and 42 (was 61 and 34)
Rip deals more a tick at every rank: rank 1 4 (was 3), rank 6 19 (was 15)
Ferocious Bite's damage and the damage each extra point of Energy adds increase at every rank: rank 1 17 and 70 (was 14 and 60), rank 6 102 and 330 (was 82 and 270)
Starfire's damage increases at every rank: rank 1 113 (was 81), rank 7 533 (was 381), and it gains more a level
New passive Poised: at full Energy and out of combat, your next ability costs less Energy
Aimed Shot's bonus damage roughly doubles at every rank: rank 1 40 (was 20), rank 6 350 (was 166)
Sniper Shot's bonus damage doubles at every rank: rank 1 320 (was 160), rank 3 590 (was 295)
Arcane Shot's damage increases at every rank: rank 1 25 (was 20), rank 8 280 (was 217)
Serpent Sting deals more a tick at every rank: rank 1 3 (was 2), rank 9 135 (was 111)
Aspect of the Hawk's ranged attack power increases at every rank: rank 1 20 (was 15), rank 6 110 (was 55)
Trueshot Aura's attack power increases at every rank: rank 1 20 (was 15), rank 3 50 (was 30), rank 5 100 (was 50)
Holy Shield rank 4 now costs 240 mana and has a 10-second cooldown, as its other ranks do
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization now increases Holy damage too
The talent trees are reworked: 7 talents become new ones, 2 talents get places of their own, Improved Distract is removed and 21 talents move
Death Mark replaces Thousand Cuts: a finishing move that marks the target and stores part of the damage your attacks deal to it, per combo point, then deals it when the mark ends, up to a cap
Garrote and Rupture are stored at twice the rate
25 Energy, 20 yards, a 10-second cooldown, 4 ranks
New ability Shank: an off-hand strike for 50% weapon damage that cannot miss and gives 15 Energy, for 5 Energy, with a 10-second cooldown
A second form of it gives 25 Energy
Boot Knife replaces Cutthroat: Shank gets a chance to add combo points
Flash of Steel takes Dual Wield Specialization's place: Shank gives more Energy and has a shorter cooldown
Dual Wield Specialization moves to a place of its own with 2 ranks
Venom now works through Shank: Shank raises your Poison damage and your chance to apply Poisons for a while
Quick Getaway replaces Quietus: one more target can be Sapped, and Sapping gives 35% movement speed for a while, 2 ranks
Vigor replaces Murder: more maximum Energy, 2 ranks
Blood Splatter replaces Vigor: Rupture lasts 4 seconds longer and Garrote 6 seconds
Composure takes Relentless Strikes' place: Poised lowers Energy costs further, 2 ranks
Relentless Strikes moves to a new place with 5 ranks
Coup de Grace, renamed from Improved Eviscerate, now also raises Death Mark's damage and storage rate by 20%
The former Coup de Grace, more Eviscerate damage against targets with your Deadly Poison, is gone
Efficient Strikes is the new name of Improved Sinister Strike
Ghostly Strike now also lets your next Ambush or Garrote be used without Stealth
Mutilate loses its first rank: the talent teaches the former rank 2, and its ranks are numbered 1 to 3
Flawless Execution now lowers Eviscerate's cost by 15 Energy
Seal Fate now has 3 ranks (was 5), Lethality 2 (was 5), Camouflage 3 (was 5), and Opportunity 5 (was 2)
Improved Distract is removed
New passive Poised: at full Energy and out of combat, your next ability costs less Energy
The top ranks of Poisons get more charges: Instant Poison VI 250 (was 175), Deadly Poison IV and Wound Poison IV 240 (was 160), Deadly Poison V 240 (was 180), Mind-numbing Poison III 225 (was 150)
Lightning Bolt's damage increases at every rank: rank 1 16 (was 15), rank 10 353 (was 196), and from rank 4 on it gains more a level
Chain Lightning now has a 2.5-second cast at every rank, costs more mana and deals far more damage: rank 1 215 for 245 mana (was 88 for 145), rank 4 510 for 495 (was 123 for 315)
Earth Shock's damage increases at every rank: rank 1 20 (was 18), rank 7 531 (was 301)
Flame Shock's hit and its damage over time increase: rank 1 hits for 25 (was 20), rank 6 for 292 and 80 a tick (was 166 and 44)
Frost Shock's damage increases at every rank: rank 1 98 (was 66), rank 4 506 (was 283)
Stormstrike now strikes for 150% weapon damage, with a 6-second cooldown
Riptide no longer heals at once, only over time, for less mana and with a 12-second cooldown: rank 1 150 mana (was 245), rank 3 230 (was 385)
points.was: an instant heal and a heal over time, 6 seconds

points.text: Totemic Projection is renamed Totemic Call and moves your active totems to you, with a 30-second cooldown
points.was: to a place you choose, 1 minute

points.text: Call of Thunder replaces Lava Burst in the talent tree: 5% more critical strike chance for Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning
Elemental Mastery is renamed Lightning Mastery and no longer speaks of Lava Burst
Elemental Reach no longer shortens Totemic Projection's cooldown
Improved Ghost Wolf and Improved Lightning Shield move in the talent tree
Wrack's damage now grows by 2.5 a level
Slam's cooldown is now 15 seconds at every rank
Improved Slam now shortens Slam's cooldown by 5 seconds
Improved Whirlwind replaces Raging Blows: Whirlwind's cooldown is 2 seconds shorter and it deals 30% more damage to the closest enemy, 2 ranks
points.was: Raging Blows: less Rage for Cleave and Whirlwind, 1 rank

points.text: Spearing Strike now deals 75% weapon damage, and 75% more against Giants, Dragonkin and mounted targets
New talent Reckless Swings: your next melee attacks generate extra Rage, with a 15-second cooldown
Flurry now has 3 ranks (was 5), Improved Tactical Mastery 3 (was 5), and Bloodthrill 2 (was 5)
Enrage and Gore Drinker move in the talent tree, and the arrows at Death Wish and Blood Craze change
New toy: Pouch of Violet Dust, thrown into a campfire to change its flames
Brittle Key, Stone Key, Keystone Fragment, Ancient Runestone and Dormant Runestone now go on the keyring, and the last three count as keys
Torn Page and Dormant Runestone are now unique
Letter Opener now sells for 1 silver 70 copper
Brittle Key now sells for 17 copper (was nothing)
Your Battle.net broadcast can no longer be set from the contacts menu, and the option Broadcast Updates is gone
Friends' broadcasts still show in their tooltips
The amount a unit's hit or heal took (the event UNIT_COMBAT) is now hidden from addons
Nameplate aura icons no longer show a tooltip
Friends' game icons can show which of a game's projects they play
The action bar's end caps hide when they do not fit on the screen
The Spell Damage and Spell Healing tooltips no longer say that low spell ranks trigger class abilities less often
Group Finder entries' names get less room
New for addons: whether a spell is its highest rank (C_ActionBar.IsHighestSpellRank)
63 interface code files changed, no picture
The ground, water, maps, flights and boats are unchanged
96 new light settings and 2 new kinds of weather, and some weather gets a new ambient sound

sane: The database reads a spell's cost as a share of base mana (Arcane Shot's 11%); 105 spells' costs corrected in the versions they had
Checked: a whisper to a title friend through Social's chat line and contacts works as before

points.text: Everything here is compared with build 70755 and the hotfixes the game held on November 3, the day before launch; the servers ran builds 70790, 70862 and 70888 in between, so their changes are in here too
Blizzard has published no patch notes for this build. Its hotfix log of November 5 to 13 is compared point by point.

Since launch the servers have sent the client 1,326 older items, 41 auras and the areas of four dungeons it lacked (The Drowned City, Blackmaw Hold, The Shaper's Terrace, Krol'dok Stronghold), with the Drowned City's encounter Min'loth the Serpent: they are known now, not new in the game, and stand only in the list of every change
11 item sets the client always held count now, their items being known: The Gladiator, Dal'Rend's Arms and Spider's Kiss among them
One item is new in the build itself: a second Berdun's Trusty Rifle
The item restoration service is turned off while a serious bug is looked into
Druids in Shadowmeld can no longer use Ravage and Pounce
Command's second effect drops to 0%, so some Warlock pet abilities no longer gain too much from it
Cultivation's cooldown starts only once its cast is done
Stuns now have diminishing returns against creatures, Kidney Shot among them
The Cooldown Manager shows crowd control durations at all times
A bug with the talent The Quick and the Dead is fixed
Bear Form raises the threat you cause by 115%
Bloom heals its target
Omen of Clarity works again after you switch specialization
The Idol of Ferocity lowers only Claw's and Rake's cost, no longer Mangle's
The Cooldown Manager no longer shows Berserk and now shows Lacerate
The tooltips of Bear Form, Ravage and Swiftmend are corrected
Feral Charge (Cat) puts you in combat at once
Natural Instinct now applies to Lacerate and Pounce
Rend and Tear works on Pounce's bleed
Pounce's stun shows on the enemy as a debuff
Wild Growth's healing coefficient doubles to 6.6% at every rank
Wild Growth can no longer be cast while moving
Nature's Swiftness makes Wild Growth instant too
Arcane Shot costs 11% of your base mana at every rank
Hunter pets have 115% health
The pet skill Great Stamina raises a pet's health directly: 30 at rank 1 to 400 at rank 10
Volley no longer sets off procs, and moving ends its channel
Hunters no longer pull creatures from far away just by targeting them
Vulgara the Insatiable and the Shrieklings of Zephras belong to their right pet families
Summon Hawk costs 11% of your base mana at every rank
The hawk deals about 80% more melee damage
Damage from procs and from Blizzard breaks Frost Nova
Flamestrike's ticks no longer use up Clearcasting
Arcane Concentration's chance is split between a cast and each of its bolts
points.was: 10% for the cast and for each bolt

points.text: Research is gone: only Study is left once its quest is done
Arcane Blast lasts 18 seconds
Judgements are ranged attacks: they set off no melee effects and use your ranged hit chance
Judgement of Light, Wisdom, Righteousness, Justice, the Crusader and Fury, at every rank

Consecration's damage bonus keeps working when its targets despawn
Redoubt and the Seals can be tracked in the Cooldown Manager

Confounding Flash, the Gnomes' ability, can be used in Shadowform
Fear Ward can be cast in Shadowform without ending it
The legacy perk The Quick and the Dead lowers Divine Spirit's mana cost too
Power Infusion stays on allies as it should
The Revelation enchant no longer triggers from Vampiric Embrace
Twilight Focus works in Shadowform
Holy Nova is unlearned when you drop its talent
Shank's tooltip names its Rank 1 and Rank 2
With Boot Knife, Shank's tooltip shows the combo points it can add
Weapon imbues and weapon totems work together: Windfury Weapon and Windfury Totem can both proc
The tooltips of Windfury Weapon and Flametongue Weapon no longer say they turn off Windfury Totem
Windfury Totem procs from every melee ability; a strike with the off-hand alone, such as Whirlwind or Mutilate, does not, the main-hand strike does
Lightning Overload's extra Lightning Bolt deals more damage at every rank: rank 1 8 (was 7), rank 10 176.5 (was 98)
Its Chain Lightning hits harder too: rank 1 107.5 (was 44), rank 4 255 (was 62), and takes 35.7% of your spell power (was 28.6%)
Flametongue Totem rank 2 works again
Lightning Mastery has a new look
Maelstrom Weapon can be tracked in the Cooldown Manager
Improved Ghost Wolf keeps the Night Watchman's Torch in your hand
Stormstrike deals 100% weapon damage and has an 8-second cooldown
Mental Dexterity turns 33/66/100% of your Intellect into attack power
Maelstrom Weapon cuts cast time and mana cost by 20% a stack at every rank, and procs 6, 7, 8, 9 or 10 times a minute by rank
points.was: 4 to 20% by rank, 20 times a minute

points.text: Its chance comes from your main-hand weapon's speed, as its tooltip now says
Summon Felsteed teaches the riding skill it needs
The Imp's Firebolt hits harder at ranks 1 to 4 and gains more a level: rank 1 6 (was 4), rank 4 18 (was 17)
The Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus and Succubus have about 15% more base health; the Voidwalker about 40 more at every level besides
Incinerate is for Destruction only
The Succubus's whip sounds as it should
Wrack deals 30% less damage and no longer raises your other effects' damage; while you channel it, your Siphon Life, Corruption and Bane of Agony on the target tick 100% faster
Rank 1: 25.2 a tick and 1.75 more a level (was 36 and 2.5)
Soul Siphon counts only your Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony on the target, 4/8/12% each, up to 36%
Siphon Life rank 1 can no longer be cast while silenced
Bane of Havoc triggers the global cooldown
Berserker Rage removes Sap and guards against it while it lasts
Gore Drinker's tooltip names Reckless Swings
Thunderclap shows only its cooldown in the Cooldown Manager
Sweeping Strikes no longer loses charges without a second target
Defensive Stance raises the threat you cause by 80%
Defiance raises it by a further 7/13/20% with a shield
Enemies trivial to a party member's level give that member no experience
Killing enemies in dungeons gives 50% more experience
Zarla Ober drops loot
Releasing after death works again

The throne room's doors open again after a wipe at Emperor Thaurissan
The Heart of the Mountain can no longer be looted more than once
Sneed is thrown out when Sneed's Shredder is stunned at 0% health
Enemies other than bosses come back after 2 hours

Its creatures no longer leave a fight for no reason
The portal into it works
Zaetar's Spirit appears as it should
Vitrix, Snowtalon and Cinder drop loot, and skinning materials of a higher level

Defeating Balnazzar counts for the legacy challenge Master Spelunker

Innkeepers give a better answer to Tell me about the dungeons I can explore

Nethergarde Keep's guards drop no loot

Yarrog Baneshadow comes back as he should

Murlocs come back as they should
A bug that drew creatures from too far, here and in Stratholme, is fixed
Techbot comes back sooner for Save Techbot's Brain!
Fewer Quillboar and Venture Co. stand in the starting area
The Twilight Enforcer's Smash deals far less damage, and Executioner Morg less

Krek the Noxious drops his right loot
Ivar the Foul comes back as he should
Tigers, panthers and raptors appear more often
Pelluk appears as he should
Ferocitas comes back sooner
Lasher Sproutlings, Blooming Lashers and Wrathvine can be hurt by Nature damage
Young Diemetradons are level 58
Malduko Cloudcrush comes back a little more slowly
Nyalah Brightfire sells more cooking supplies
Lotheluum Starbreeze trains Druids
Every racial vendor's mount binds on pickup
82 mounts, the Galestriders among them

Waylaid Crates and Craftsman's Writs drop in dungeons
Zephras Isle's trade supply vendors sell the apprentice tradeskill bags

Journeyman Campfire turns grey at 95 (was 105), Expert Campfire at 205 (was 220)

The second tier of camp crafts turns grey 5 sooner: Anvil, Arcane Salvager, Fermenter, Field Guide, Greenhouse, Repair Bot, Rock Garden, Spinning Wheel and Toxin Study at 140 (was 145), Cookie's Feast at 145 (was 150)
The first camp crafts turn grey at 20 (was 25): Camp Tent, Camp Chair, Enchanted Lute, Faction Banner, First Aid Kit, Incense Candle, Lodestone, Mana Well, Reagent Bot and Sharpening Wheel
Arcane Salvager needs a Runed Golden Rod
Recipe: Elixir of Greater Firepower is now Recipe: Elixir of Holy Power, and the elixir's effect is Holy Power
Lesser Spirit enchants for boots and bracers give Spirit
Swiftstrike Shot and Swiftfeather Arrow no longer bind on pickup
Minor Arcane Elixir sells for 5 copper
Iron Grenade sells for 1 silver 25 copper
Draught of Water Walking and the 9-60 Battery Pack have recipe items
The Fishing Rack's lure works as it should
Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza: more players of each ruleset can win the weekly tournament
Bags take more bolts: Red Mageweave Bag 5 (was 4), Green Woolen Bag 5 (was 4), Red Woolen Bag 5 (was 4), Green Silk Pack 5 (was 4), Black Silk Pack 6 (was 5)
Most quests of level 48 and up give more gold
Crate Expectations: the Unstable Package's proc and its misfire damage are fixed
The Unstable Fuel Cell deals 140 (was 600)
Unending Torment: the Abomination Head is for the Horde from level 15

Quest items that drop for the whole party do so now: the Deadwood Key, Drop of Stolen Life, Ring of the Fallen Soldier, Venom-dripping Heart, Blackthorne Intelligence, Celastrus's, and those of The Monster Surfaces, Croaky's Head and Elmpaw's Head
The Talisman of Kazdor no longer sends rogues into the wrong Zul'Farrak
A Quick Grocery Run: everyone can read Skonk's list
Pix Xizzix's weekly quests are taken away at the weekly reset
Yashiro's Windwalk gives healers credit
Escorting Erland: Deathstalker Erland comes back sooner
The Sleeper Has Awakened gives the Horn of Awakening at its start
Rough Wolf Pelts is cancelled when you unlearn Skinning
Rescue OOX-22/FE! starts as it should in Feralas
More Glade Vipers in the Riverglades and Nightbane items in Duskwood for their quests; Murloc Tideskimmers drop Saltwater Murloc Eyes
Scarlet Diversions' Command Tent in the Western Plaguelands, the Witherbark Mallet in the Arathi Highlands and Feralas' Cage Door work again
The Sisterhood of Elune's text is fixed

Fixes to many more: Coyote Huntin', Vorsha the Lasher, Rediscovering the Light, Ammo for Rumbleshot, Poison Tips, Never Saddle on Quality, the Damp Note, Call of Water, Chief Engineer Scooty, Helping Hands, Zephras Isle's herbalism, Find Bingles, Lonebrow's Journal, A Recipe for Death, Fetch 'n' Fletch, Mission: Possible not Probable, Bloodmaster's Ring, Feathers in Flight, Jom-jom's Escape, Ever After, Unwelcome Guests, The Deathstalkers, and the book-taking NPCs of the Undercity and Stormwind
A group invite from another shard warns that accepting may refresh the world around you
A whisper to a title friend goes to their character as a normal whisper
A new chat channel: OOC
The message when too many characters are made in a short time says what to do
Action bar settings no longer reset at logout for characters with secondary talents

For addon authors: C_TradeSkillUI.HasNoReagentCost, C_BattleNet.GetDefaultTitleWhisperTarget and ChatFrameUtil.GetCharacterWhisperTargetIfTitleFriend are new; C_TransmogOutfitInfo.GetSecondarySlotState and SetSecondarySlotState take an option; PARTY_INVITE_REQUEST tells whether the invite crosses shards; ShouldShowBattlePetIcon is gone
You can mount in Shen'dralas' Valley of Bones, Magram Front, Outcast Hideaway, Bristleback Retreat, Evenshade's Overlook and Forlorn Gardens
The flight from Camp Taurajo to Thunder Bluff is fixed
The Horde zeppelin between Mulgore and Zephras Isle takes a slightly longer way
6,013 yards (was 5,956)
Nine new portal spells: to Dalaran, Auberdine, Stormwind, Southshore, Theramore, Menethil, the Undercity, Orgrimmar and Grom'gol
Crowded zones hold fewer players, more so on the PvP ruleset
Graveyards after death are fixed
Pyrewood Village's villagers appear at dawn and dusk
Distant players and their targets are easier to see
Thunder Bluff's barbershop is lit as it should be

sane: Checked: the mail window on Inventory's full screen and Economy's Banker on the Send Mail page work as before; only the cash on delivery button changed
The world is as before (terrain, buildings and models byte for byte): the walking data and the instance maps stand

points.text: Everything here is compared with build 70938 and the hotfixes the game held then; Blizzard's hotfix log for Forever of November 16 and 17 is merged in, and where the client shows the same the point says so
Blizzard has published no patch notes for this build
Might of Stormwind and Warchief's Blessing end when you die, and no longer land on non-player characters
Vampiric Embrace heals your party for 10% of the Shadow spell damage you deal, and you receive 100% more healing from it yourself
Dark Inspiration no longer stacks with several Shadow priests in one party
The Tier 1 set's 5-piece bonus lowers the cost of Eviscerate and Death Mark by 5 Energy
Poisons can no longer be ranked past their highest rank
Shank on a target without your combo points no longer takes those on other targets, unless Boot Knife is talented
Wild Growth's ranks go on cooldown as they should
Genesis raises Pounce's bleed damage too
Flurry no longer loses stacks wrongly when Windfury Totem's attacks land
Windfury Totem's attacks respect armour and have an internal cooldown, and its extra attacks generate Rage
Mutilate and Execute no longer try Windfury Totem a second time; Shield Slam, Shield Bash and Holy Strikes empowered by Shieldworn no longer try it at all
Maelstrom Weapon serves one cast only
Thundering Strikes' critical strike chance no longer needs a weapon equipped
The Revered Champion offers Legacy of Valor to the Warriors who qualify
Cleave and Heroic Strike activate Unbridled Wrath and Reckless Swings, and no longer use up Flurry's stacks
Its enemies' health and damage are raised to what was meant: it takes a full group again
Captain Dreadrise can be stunned, and the Abyssal Bubble he summons can no longer block, dodge or parry
The rare "Pyromancer" Braxton fights back
The Atal'alarion statues in the Pit of Refuse stay usable after one is activated out of order
Pesterhide Snarlers and Needles Cougars no longer spawn inside a rock, nor Gravelsnout Diggers and Surveyors walk into one

The dungeon armour sets have set bonuses: Battlegear of Heroism, Beastmaster Armor, Darkmantle Armor, Deathmist Raiment, Feralheart Raiment, Sorcerer's Regalia, Soulforge Armor, The Five Thunders and Vestments of the Virtuous. Each gives All Resistances at 2 pieces, mana or health every 5 seconds at 3, a chance on attack or spellcast at 4, a chance when struck at 5, and spell damage and healing, Attack Power or Strength at 6

Each of those sets has 8 new pieces, one for every slot (Feralheart Wrists, Waist, Shoulders, Legs, Helm, Gloves, Boots and Chest; Wrists of Heroism and so on): 72 items of item level 65 that bind when picked up, and the sets' earlier pieces count towards them too

New items besides: Lady Maye's Pendant (epic), Scales of the Devourer, Ancient Giant's Gaze, Cannibal's Cleaver, the Shattered and the Reforged Atal'ai Spear, Filcher's Cowl, Shadow Scalper, Hardened Stone Band, Arcanum of Binding and a Scrawled Note; and 15 rare pieces of item level 61 to 63: Huntsman's Harpoon, Hammer of Revitalization, Tome of Divine Right, Amalgam's Band, Band of the Steadfast Hero, Hammer of Divine Might, Draconian Aegis of the Legion, Shroud of Domination, Pendant of Celerity, Leggings of Torment, Handguards of Savagery, Totem of Tides, Idol of Rejuvenation, Libram of Hope and Boots of Ferocity
Darkmoon Card: Heroism, Darkmoon Card: Blue Dragon, Darkmoon Card: Maelstrom and Darkmoon Card: Twisting Nether are item level 65
Darkmoon Card: Blue Dragon has a 3% chance on spellcast to raise your Spirit
Darkmoon Card: Maelstrom's lightning deals twice as much damage to Aquatic enemies
Darkmoon Card: Heroism heals you twice as often in Strongholds and Cities
Rider of the Plaguelands' 3-piece bonus, Lash of the Dark Rider, has a 15% chance on melee attack to deal 140 Shadow damage
The bonus is another spell of the same name: before, the strike itself
Howling Hide's Howler's Cry is a 10% chance on hit to lower the target's attack power by 60
Filcher's Cowl raises your effective stealth level by 1
Formula: Enchant Boots - Speed, the reputation reward, binds when picked up
Crackling Staff has the stats of Whiteout Staff: 25 Stamina, 25 Intellect and 74 Spell Power from its weapon damage
Soulforge Armor, the paladins' upgraded dungeon set for tanks, has Spell Power instead of Strength
Soulforge Wristguards, Waistguard, Pauldrons, Legguards, Handguards and Sabatons
Shadow priests can equip the Night Watchman's Torch
Escape Plan's range and damage are put right
Outrider's Gloves work as they should
The Violet Tragan no longer breaks crowd control
Reagent Economy no longer stops working at random
Warsong Gulch: no mounting in the starting rooms
The Battle for Alterac Valley's quests need level 58
Arathi Basin: dying in the Gold Mine no longer sends you to a Riverglades graveyard
Waylaid Crates that turned into an obsolete turn-in item are fixed: such a crate can be turned in for the right reward
Paletusks can no longer be pickpocketed
The Old Ways teaches Orcish War Leggings through an item, Plans: Orcish War Leggings; who missed or lost it gets one from Sumi in the blacksmithing hut nearby once the quest is done
Bronze Mace binds when equipped, so the Transmog Collection takes it
The Craftsman's Writ for Golden Scale Gauntlets names the right NPC to hand it in to
Camper's Lure, new: applied to your fishing pole, it raises your Fishing by 60 for 5 minutes
The Cozy Sleeping Bag gives you Resting inside its area, can be placed in spots such as hunter traps, and is no bed for a mounted player
The client has the aura, Resting, new
The Fishing Rack gives everyone lures, and its Bloated Fish drop more often with other loot
Cultivation works on Mageroyal
Find Herb shows Her World's wildflowers only while you are on that quest
Some creatures that are not meant to be skinned can no longer be skinned
SI:7's quarters have a bin of mail, so Mathias Shaw can give rogues the letter for The Manor, Ravenholdt
Show Them How It's Done shows on the map
Blisters on the Land: more Fen Creepers in the Wetlands
Step One: Rock: Find Minerals shows the rockpiles
A New Ore Sample: more Gravelsnout Diggers and Surveyors
Agamaggan's Blood is no dungeon quest any more: it can be done in the elite area outside Razorfen Downs
Blood Red Bandanas drop more often
The Talisman of Kazdor: Witch Doctor Zum'rah appears as he should
No Soldier Left Behind: the scout prisoners in Twilight's Shroud count for the whole party
Screecher Spirits: Vale Screamers appear along the Isle of Dread's coast
The repeatable Water Pouch Bounty gives no experience
The Return of the King? in Theramore no longer gets stuck
Powering the Pylons: a repaired pylon counts for party members nearby
Heart of Crystal: the Depleted Crystal Heart drops for every party member
Going Home: Rokren escapes more slowly
Miners can track Spectral Iron Ore, and it spawns more often
Bristleback Skullcrushers and Decrepit Pylon Protectors use their abilities less often
The necromancers' Summon Undead Ravager can be interrupted
The server can turn cash on delivery off; its button then says so when you point at it
The addon list's character menu writes your name as the game shows it

For addon authors: new C_Mail.IsCODEnabled, Constants.EncodingLimits.EncodingDeserializeSizeLimit (104,857,600), GetTalentMicroButton, IsTalentTutorialEnabled, IsStarterTalentTutorialEnabled and MainMenuMicroButton_GetPlayerSpellsAlertButtons; gone ContainerFrameCombinedBagsMixin:ApplySmartNavOverrideForLeftmostButton
Ignore lists are kept through a logout
Master Swordsmith, Master Axesmith and Master Hammersmith: an interface bug is fixed
